## Bio
Third-year Electrical & Electronics Engineering student and self-taught programmer. Builds software from zero-to-one — production ML pipelines, compiler infrastructure, and the distributed systems in between. Work bridges bare-metal inference and responsive UI. Custom ASR systems, voice-first clinical AI, and privacy-by-design infrastructure.

## Areas of expertise
